The new public selected/full JMH fixture reproduced a baseline resource difference at exact ScalaFIM fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc plus PLS Neuro patch 58ff8af4dd57cfeabff7bc9a59f5e2323c2aa9e3cfd61e35596f502d333d7adf: shared OLS FitPlanExecutor.fitChunked with 64 voxels and ChunkSize(32) requests the full 64-voxel response during PreparedFitContexts.prepare -> OrdinaryLeastSquares.prepareContext before bounded fitting. A reader enforcing 32 fails there. Pooled full execution stays within 32 in this fixture. The selected paths retain their 32-voxel guard. Raw reproduction: /private/tmp/plsneuro-selected-jmh-smoke.log; benchmark source currently isolated under /private/tmp/plsneuro-selective-providers-1/scalafim-fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc/benchmarks/fit-jvm/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/SelectedFirstLevelBenchmark.scala.

Qualification will preserve the old full route as-is, report its observed largest read separately, and keep the selected guard strict. This is a baseline observation, not a timing claim or a change in scientific fit semantics. The existing out-of-core preparation issue bd-01KX6G9B1ZT10A3214DPA096RZ remains the proper owner of broader full-path preparation work. Native selective compilation already avoids this preparation read. The first harness covers resident synthetic inputs and full/selected equivalence only; filesystem/decompression/verification/sink and independent external measurement remain open SE3 work.
